# Your Mind Story

> Your Mind Story is the online Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy practice of Onye, a Clinical Cognitive-Behavioural Hypnotherapist (member of the Federation of Holistic Therapists, fully insured), based in the UK. It helps women caught in the pattern of an avoidant or inconsistent relationship, whether they are still in it, out of it but still caught, or seeing it start again.

The focus is not on diagnosing him. It is on what the pattern is doing to her: the checking, replaying, waiting, second-guessing and reversing decisions she meant. Understanding the pattern is not the same as changing the response to it, so the work uses Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy (cognitive techniques, behavioural practice, focused attention, imagery and suggestion) to practise a different response when the urge actually appears. Women do not have to leave the relationship or be over him to start.

The work runs in four stages: Quiet the Alarm (the reaction that knocks you off-centre), Break the Pull (checking, replaying, reassurance-seeking and reaching out), Restore Self-Trust (second-guessing and reversing decisions) and Return to You (bringing attention and life back to yourself).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/): what Your Mind Story is, who it is for, and the four stages.
- [Free assessment](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/assessment/): 15 questions, around 3 minutes, with a personalised result showing where the pattern is affecting you most and where to start.
- [Why This Works](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/why-this-works.html): what Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy means here, why insight alone may not change a response, and what the research (including a 2021 meta-analysis of hypnosis alongside CBT) can and cannot tell us.
- [About Onye](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/about.html): how Onye came to hypnotherapy and why the practice focuses on what the pattern does to you.
- [Online hypnotherapy for anxiety](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/anxiety-hypnotherapy/): one-to-one online sessions for anxiety, stress and overthinking, with a specialism in relationship anxiety, heartbreak and anxiety after a breakup. Enquiries by email to yourmindstory.co.uk@gmail.com.
- [Return to Yourself: The Complete Four-Stage Journey](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/return-to-yourself-journey/): all four guided Cognitive Behavioural Hypnotherapy sessions with weekly check-in support.
- [Success stories](https://yourmindstory.co.uk/success-stories.html): experiences from women who have used Your Mind Story.
- [Shop](https://stan.store/Yourmindstory): the guided sessions, sold individually, in pairs or as the complete journey.
